from __future__ import annotations

import dataclasses
import typing

import pytest
from PIL import Image

from llm_router import Model, Provider, ProviderError
from llm_router._internal.capabilities.content import normalize_content
from llm_router._internal.providers.base import ProviderRequest
import llm_router._internal.providers.qwenchat
from llm_router._internal.providers.qwenchat import QwenChatAdapter

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


@dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True)
class _FakeFailure:
    message: str = "upload failed"


@pytest.mark.verifies("TREQ_QWENCHAT_ADAPTER_BOUNDARY[revision==1]")
async def test_qwenchat_aexecute_raises_provider_error_on_media_upload_failure(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    image = Image.new("RGB", (1, 1))
    image.format = "PNG"
    request = ProviderRequest(
        provider=Provider.QWENCHAT,
        model=next(iter(Model)),
        provider_model="qwen-chat",
        messages=[normalize_content([image])],
    )
    expected_failure = _FakeFailure()
    expected_error = ProviderError(
        expected_failure,
        request.provider,
        request.model,
        message=expected_failure.message,
    )
    adapter = QwenChatAdapter(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:1/api")

    chat_called = False

    async def fake_post(
        *_args: typing.Any,
        **_kwargs: typing.Any,
    ) -> typing.Any:
        nonlocal chat_called
        chat_called = True
        raise AssertionError("Chat request must not be sent")

    async def fake_upload(
        *_args: typing.Any,
        **_kwargs: typing.Any,
    ) -> typing.Any:
        raise expected_error

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        llm_router._internal.providers.qwenchat.httpx.AsyncClient,
        "post",
        fake_post,
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        llm_router._internal.providers.qwenchat,
        "upload_media_async",
        fake_upload,
    )

    with pytest.raises(ProviderError) as exc_info:
        await adapter.aexecute(request)

    assert exc_info.value is expected_error
    assert exc_info.value.provider == request.provider
    assert exc_info.value.model == request.model
    assert exc_info.value.failure == expected_failure
    assert not chat_called
